exposure: number of maternal comorbidities (chronic hypertension, pregestational diabetes, chronic kidney disease, systemic lupus erythematosus)
outcome: proportion of potential expectant management time achieved
cohort: Patients with preeclampsia with severe features delivering live, nonanomalous singletons between 23 to 34 2/7 weeks' gestation.
finding: The number of maternal comorbidities was not associated with the duration of expectant management, but patients with two or more comorbidities had higher odds of adverse maternal outcomes.
